extracted.intended_audience: public relations professionals / press-release writers / corporate communicators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for composing the standardized concluding paragraph of a press release that summarizes the organization (overview, mission, achievements), provides contact information and links, and is concise and reusable across templates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release boilerplate (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: A press release boilerplate is a standardized paragraph at the end of a press release that provides key information about your organization. It includes a brief company overview, mission statement, core products or services and contact information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the boilerplate as part of every press release and incorporate it into your press release templates so journalists and readers have consistent background context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Company Overview
rubrics_metrics.description: The company overview is a brief introduction to your organization that summarizes its history, industry and key activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typically include the official company name, founding year, major milestones and a snapshot of the products or services you offer to help the reader quickly understand who your organization is.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission and Vision
rubrics_metrics.description: The mission statement explains your organization's purpose and the core goals it strives to achieve. The vision statement outlines your long-term goal and the impact you want to make.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these to connect with journalists and customers by speaking to shared values; make them concise and meaningful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Share Your Values
rubrics_metrics.description: Including company values in your press release boilerplate showcases your mission, vision, core principles and commitment to philanthropy and social causes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sharing values humanizes your organization and helps build a connection with your audience, fostering trust and loyalty among journalists, customers and investors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key Achievements
rubrics_metrics.description: Highlighting key achievements helps establish credibility and demonstrates a successful track record.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This section might include awards, recognitions, major projects, significant partnerships or milestones such as reaching a certain number of customers or revenue goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact Details
rubrics_metrics.description: A news release boilerplate typically concludes with the contact details of your media or public relations representative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear contact information (e.g., media/PR contact name, phone, email) so journalists can easily request interviews or ask follow-up questions, increasing the likelihood of coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Length (conciseness)
rubrics_metrics.description: A press release boilerplate should be around 100 words long.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep it concise yet informative, summarizing key details about the company without overwhelming the reader so journalists can quickly gather necessary background information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Placement
rubrics_metrics.description: The boilerplate goes at the end of a press release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placing it at the end ensures readers receive the news first, then the background context provided by the boilerplate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keywords for SEO
rubrics_metrics.description: Although your press release boilerplate has a very small impact on your search engine rankings, if you can include relevant keywords in a way that makes the boilerplate more descriptive, it makes sense to do so.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include relevant keywords only when they naturally make the boilerplate more descriptive; avoid keyword stuffing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include links and channels (website, investor, newsroom, social, helplines)
rubrics_metrics.description: Boilerplates often include links and contact channels such as the company website, newsroom, investor pages, social media handles, and helpline numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide relevant links (e.g., about page, investor relations, newsroom) and social handles or phone numbers as appropriate — examples in the article show inclusion of investor pages, helplines, and social media handles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporate boilerplate into templates / use consistently
rubrics_metrics.description: The boilerplate should be included as part of every press release and incorporated into all of your press release templates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain consistency across releases so background information is standardized and readily available to journalists and stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid industry jargon
rubrics_metrics.description: Make sure to avoid industry jargon in this section of your boilerplate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use plain, accessible language so journalists and general audiences can quickly understand your organization's purpose and relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grammar and SEO best practices / editorial review
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the boilerplate is grammatically correct and follows search engine optimization best practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If using a distribution or editorial service, they may fix grammatical mistakes and implement SEO best practices; otherwise, have the boilerplate edited to follow best practices for clarity, grammar, and discoverability.
